label: Crickets ground into burgers as the replacement for beef
description: Beef shortages following what was done to the chickens and eggs, and crickets ground into burgers and patties presented as an alternative protein, which he calls planned population control rather than anything wrong with the cattle. He acknowledges viewers telling him insect protein is already eaten elsewhere.
aliases: Cricut burgers
There's nothing wrong with your cows
an alternative source of protein

label: People in a kettle whose water is rising without their noticing
description: People seen with their noses to the ground, too busy paying bills to look at the horizon, sitting in a kettle whose water level and temperature are both rising. Unfalsifiable in form: inattention is the thing being described, so nothing could count against it.
aliases: they didn't realize they were in a pot that was starting to boil
their nose to the ground
the edge of the horizon of time

label: Three more rats around the president to be identified
description: Three other major rats around the president who must be found out, given with prayer that he know who to trust. He names nobody, so the number three is the only checkable part.
aliases: there's three other major rats
expose the rat within
who to trust and who not to trust

label: The lions on the Stock Exchange, and Wall Street closed down
description: Lions carved into the side of a building he later learns is the New York Stock Exchange, tumbleweeds blowing down Wall Street, and the exchange completely closed when the major event happens, with Chinook helicopters flying aid in from the west coast so low the houses vibrate. The exchange has closed for more than a day only a handful of times.
aliases: tumble weeds going down Wall Street
the lion on the side of the building
Wall Street was completely closed down

label: Over 1,800 dead from Texarkana to Tulsa, and the OU building split
description: In the New Madrid earthquake, over 1,800 dead between Texarkana and Tulsa, the large skyscraper-like building at the University of Oklahoma split down the middle and burning, houses on cinder blocks levelled while houses on foundations survive, and thousands dead in total. A figure and a named building together, which makes this the most specific form of the New Madrid claim.
aliases: I saw over 1,800 people die
the massive building that's at OU
houses that were built on cinder blocks

label: A plane from central America to Boston whose instruments go blank
description: A major flight leaving the central part of the United States for the Boston area, its dash going completely blank halfway there, and falling. He assumes a cyber attack while saying he does not know how one would reach an aircraft, and raises himself whether it is one specific flight or an example.
aliases: its dash went completely blank and it fell
it was going northeast to like Boston
I was assuming cyber attacks

label: Offshore Chinese earthquakes at 6.5 and 6.1
description: Earthquakes in China all on the sea in one area, with the numbers 6.5 and 6.1 seen. Two magnitudes given together is unusually specific for this corpus; China averages roughly one magnitude 6 event a year and offshore ones are rarer.
aliases: I see earthquakes in China
I see the number 6.5
All on the sea

label: Fear of touching blue euro notes speeds the digital system in
description: Blue paper money with a blue design that people are afraid to touch in case it carries the virus, identified in the room as the euro, which he says will be one of the first dominoes to fall, and the fear of cash brings the new system in faster. Some retailers refused notes during COVID, so a repeat would need to go further to count.
aliases: they didn't want to touch the blue money
Watch the euro
one of the first dominoes to fall

label: Everyone to wear a tracking device, read as the beast system
description: He points to Kennedy saying Americans should wear a tracking device on the body or wrist and have a digital ID, and reads it as the mark of the beast arriving faster than people realise. Kennedy's remark was about wearable health trackers, which he restates as tracking devices in arms.
aliases: putting uh tracking devices on people's arms
some kind of digital ID
does he even realize what he's saying

label: Factories shut down with contamination signs and caution tape
description: A factory shut with a contamination sign and caution tape across the doors, in cold weather with people in heavy coats and almost nobody outside, in either Chicago or New York. He cannot decide between the two cities, which halves the specificity.
aliases: caution tape across the doors
Factories will be shut down
It's either Chicago or it's New York

label: A white cargo van among casually dressed New York crowds
description: Crowds walking the streets of New York in jeans and t-shirts rather than suits, which he marks as unusual, and a white cargo van seen among them. White vans and casual crowds are the ordinary state of a New York street, so nothing here departs from the baseline.
aliases: I see a white van. It's a cargo van
There's no suits
lots of people walking in the streets

label: Four Californian fires, deliberately started
description: Many fires in California that are being deliberately started, which he begins counting and reaches four. Arson is already a confirmed cause in a share of Californian fires every year, so the count is the only distinguishing part.
aliases: They're being started
I'll count them. One and two, three, four
many, many fires in California

label: A new industrial revolution that leaves crypto already behind
description: AI and quantum computing bringing a new industrial revolution with cures for diseases and scientific breakthroughs, so fast that crypto is already ancient by comparison, alongside adversaries using the same technology for cyber attacks on old infrastructure. The Neuralink demonstrations he cites had already been published.
aliases: crypto is already behind
a great explosion of industrial revolution
quantum computing
